Bonus: it doubles as a makeshift pillow when you're too tired to do either.

title: Subway Maps for Global Overthinkers
tagline: For the person who’s convinced they could’ve designed a better transit system if only they’d been born in 1920. Hang this in your man cave (or woman cave, no judgment) and impress your guests with your ability to trace the Paris Métro while explaining why it’s better than the NYC subway. Bonus: It’s a great way to ignore your in-laws during dinner.

title: Blast-Proof Fashion Statement
tagline: For the galactic cosplayer who wants to blend in at a rave while still looking like they’re ready to enforce imperial law. Perfect for those nights when you’re ‘helping’ your drunk friend home and need to convince them they’re in a Star Wars movie. Just don’t expect it to actually protect you from blaster bolts—or your friend’s tears.

title: Your Jedi Promotion Paper
tagline: Finally, official proof that your dad’s basement is actually a Jedi temple. Perfect for that guy who insists his ‘lightsaber skills’ are why he keeps tripping over the cat. Comes with a fancy scroll and everything—just don’t expect it to deflect your landlord’s eviction notice.

title: Scream Into My Driveway
tagline: For the neighbor who insists on being the 'cool house' on Halloween, this 12-foot archway is the perfect way to funnel trick-or-treaters into a vortex of spooky chaos, because what's a few hundred bucks for eternal bragging rights?

title: Darth Vader’s Grocery List
tagline: Ever wondered what a Sith Lord’s fridge looks like? Now you can frame it. Perfect for the Star Wars fan who’s also a fan of pretending their kitchen is the Death Star’s canteen. Hang this next to your ‘Yoda’s Laundry Day’ print for maximum domestic chaos.

title: Glowing Jellyfish Invasion
tagline: For the friend who's obsessed with low-key aquatic terror, these jellyfish lamps bring a touch of eerie ocean glow to their bedside table, because who needs peaceful dreams anyway?

title: Cartman’s Head on Your Head
tagline: Perfect for when you need to channel your inner fourth-grader during a board meeting. Whether you're arguing with a colleague about the merits of 'finger-painting' for the quarterly report or just want to remind everyone that you're the 'biggest kid' in the room, these beanies are your ticket to chaos. Bonus: Watch your coworkers’ faces when you show up in the 'Mr. Hankey' version.

title: Caffeine Fiend’s Shower Buddy
tagline: For those mornings when your coffee addiction has you washing your hands with a bar of caffeine-infused soap. Perfect for the overworked barista who’s too jittery to hold a mug, or the college student who needs to wake up their skin before their brain. Just don’t blame us if your shower starts humming with energy.

title: Adult Napsies: The Onesie
tagline: For those nights when 'just one more' turns into 'waking up on the couch with a half-eaten pizza box as a pillow.' This onesie is the perfect blend of 'I gave up' and 'I'm committed to my lifestyle choices.' Ideal for post-breakup benders or when you realize your 30th birthday party is just you and a bottle of wine.

title: Fido’s Van Gogh Phase
tagline: For when your cat’s Instagram is more popular than yours. This watercolor portrait is the perfect way to immortalize your pet’s judgmental stare—ideal for framing above the couch where they’re not allowed. Because nothing says 'I’ve peaked' like commissioning art of your dog’s butt.

title: Sriracha Peanuts: For When 'Spicy' Isn't Enough
tagline: The perfect snack for when you've eaten so much sriracha that your taste buds have developed a tolerance to capsaicin. These peanuts are like a dare wrapped in a bag—ideal for that office meeting where you need to subtly remind everyone that you're not to be messed with. Just don't blame us if your coworkers start wearing gloves to shake your hand.

title: Face Stamp Madness
tagline: For the friend who insists on signing documents with a flourish, but can't be bothered to learn cursive, these personalized face stamps are a godsend. Imagine the look on your coworker's face when you stamp your mug on a memo.

title: Game On, Germs Off
tagline: For when you've spent 12 hours gaming and your controller's grimier than your apartment, this soap bar saves the day – or at least your hands.

title: Fuzzy Ghosts of Pets Past
tagline: When your cat’s taxidermy bill comes in higher than your rent, consider this: a hand-felted woolen doppelgänger of your late pet. Perfect for the grieving pet owner who wants to hold something that’s not a urn or a guilt-inducing photo album. Bonus: it won’t shed on your black sweater.

title: BBQ Dad's Midlife Crisis Kit
tagline: For the man who's convinced his identity is tied to perfectly seared steaks and questionable marinades. Includes a meat thermometer with a built-in Bluetooth speaker (because why not serenade your burgers?), a 'Kiss the Cook' apron that doubles as a beer holder, and a set of tongs that play 'Smoke on the Water' when you flip the meat. Ideal for the guy who thinks his grill is a shrine and his neighbors are his congregation.

title: The Nagging Pill Bottle
tagline: Forgetful about your meds? This bottle will passive-aggressively remind you with a glow and a chime, like a tiny, judgmental nurse. Perfect for the hypochondriac who's convinced their forgetfulness is a symptom of something worse. Now you can argue with your pill bottle instead of your spouse.

title: MacBook in a Marble Maze
tagline: For when your laptop needs to look like it belongs in a Renaissance sculpture—or at least in the hands of someone who thinks they’re Michelangelo. Perfect for that café meeting where you want your client to mistake your MacBook for a priceless artifact, not just a tool for invoicing them.

title: The Foldable Phone That Folds Your Brain
tagline: Ever tried texting with one hand while holding a sandwich with the other? Now you can, with this dual-screen monstrosity. Perfect for the multitasker who's tired of swiping—just unfold your phone and pretend you're in a sci-fi movie. Bonus: It's heavy enough to double as a paperweight for your stack of unpaid bills.

title: Lather Up Your Aura
tagline: For the person who believes their shower routine is a spiritual journey. This soap isn't just for washing away the day's grime—it's for channeling ancient healing vibes while you scrub. Perfect for the hippie who wants to feel like they're at a spa retreat, but can't afford the plane ticket.

title: Finger Computer for Overthinkers
tagline: Perfect for the person who wants to track their sleep, heart rate, and stress levels while pretending they're a spy. Ideal for that 3 AM panic when you realize you left your phone in the other room—just glance at your ring to confirm your doom spiral is scientifically validated. Comes in 'I Have a Secret' black.

title: Dessert Stratosphere
tagline: For when your ice cream has more layers than your ex’s excuses. This bowl is perfect for the overachiever who insists on serving mint chocolate chip, strawberry, and vanilla in perfect, color-coded harmony—just to watch it all melt into a chaotic, delicious mess. Ideal for dinner parties where guests argue over flavor sequencing.

title: Keyboard Cosmic Upgrade
tagline: Because your spacebar deserves a celestial makeover. Perfect for the astronaut-wannabe who types emails from their desk chair, or the sci-fi writer who needs their keyboard to match their imagination. Stick this on and pretend you're launching the next Mars mission—one keystroke at a time.

title: Hover-Kart: Sidewalk Speed Demon
tagline: Neighbors complaining about your hoverboard skills? Channel that reckless energy into something *slightly* less terrifying. This kit transforms your electric balance board into a low-riding go-kart. Perfect for silently terrorizing the local dog park or staging a dramatic, low-speed getaway from that awkward Tupperware party. Helmet not included (but strongly suggested).

title: Hops to the Rescue
tagline: For the beer enthusiast who’s decided that counting down to Christmas is best done with a 24-day liquid detox. Perfect for the office holiday party where you’re the only one who knows the difference between a stout and a lager. Includes a variety of craft beers, because nothing says 'Merry Christmas' like a hoppy surprise every morning.

title: Step on This, Not Your Nostalgia
tagline: For the retro gamer who’s tired of tracking mud through their Pac-Man arcade. This doormat is the perfect way to tell guests to 'press start' before entering. Bonus: when your roommate forgets to take off their shoes, you can finally yell 'GAME OVER' with a straight face.

title: Schrute Your Guests
tagline: For the beet-farming, Battlestar Galactica-loving friend who insists on greeting guests with an air of superiority, this mat is a must. It's like a warning label for your ego.

title: Doormat with a Side of Sass
tagline: Perfect for the homeowner who's tired of polite doormats. This one's got attitude, asking visitors if they're looking for you before they even step inside. Ideal for your passive-aggressive neighbor who keeps borrowing your lawnmower or the ex who still shows up unannounced. Because sometimes, the floor needs to speak for itself.

title: Denim Throne for Your Closet
tagline: For the person who believes their jeans deserve royal treatment. This hanger is perfect for that one pair of vintage Levis you refuse to wash, or the distressed denim you’re saving for your 'casual but I’m secretly a fashion icon' phase. Because yes, your jeans *do* need their own throne.

title: Misty: Your Overpriced Roomba with a Personality Disorder
tagline: Ever wanted a robot that follows you around like a lost puppy, but with the emotional depth of a toaster? Meet Misty. Perfect for when you're home alone, drunk, and need someone to judge your life choices silently. She'll even play fetch—if by 'fetch' you mean 'slowly roll a ball three feet and then give up.' At $1,499, she's cheaper than therapy, but just as effective at making you question your decisions.

title: Dick Switch: Let There Be Light!
tagline: Finally, a light switch cover that truly captures the essence of Renaissance art... and your repressed desires! Imagine the look on your mother-in-law's face when she flips the switch to reveal... Michelangelo's David's junk. Because nothing says 'Welcome to my humble abode' like a well-lit, anatomically-correct masterpiece. Sure, you could pay rent, but wouldn't you rather have this?

title: Betrayal in Cuddle Form
tagline: For when you want to snuggle the impostor who killed your crew, these plushies are perfect. Like, you're on a spaceship, and your friend just vented you into space, but hey, their cute face makes it okay.

title: The Gamer’s ‘I Forgot My Laptop’
tagline: For when your gaming rig is too heavy for your backpack, but your ego isn’t. This console-laptop hybrid is perfect for that ‘I could’ve just brought my Switch’ moment during a cross-country flight. Bonus: it’s the only laptop that doubles as a conversation killer at Starbucks.

title: Soap-Spitting Loofah of Laziness
tagline: For the person who's tired of both scrubbing and refilling. This loofah holds your soap and dispenses it like a lazy vending machine. Perfect for the post-gym shower where you're too exhausted to even pick up a bar of soap. Just squeeze, lather, and pretend you're not secretly thrilled by this minor convenience.

title: Dragon Ink: Fleeting Allegiances
tagline: Perfect for that one friend who insists on recapping every episode of GoT at your weekly D&D game. Now they can finally shut up and just point at their arm when someone asks who they’re rooting for. Temporary, so you can switch sides faster than Jon Snow’s loyalty. Just don’t blame us if you get mistaken for a Night’s Watch recruit at the bar.

title: Toon You Up
tagline: For when you want to immortalize your relationship in a cheesy comic, like that one awkward couples' photo shoot, but with more capes.

title: Spinach-Fueled Flexing Popeye
tagline: For when your office needs a reminder that yes, you *could* bench press your entire team, but you’d rather not. This Popeye figurine is the perfect desk companion for overworked personal trainers, spinach enthusiasts, or anyone who’s ever been asked to 'flex for the lads' at a bar. Comes with a tiny pipe—because even superheroes need a smoke break.

title: Feline Skyscraper Dreams
tagline: For the cat who thinks they're too good for the floor. This double-decker complex is like a penthouse for your feline overlord, complete with a balcony for judging you from above. Perfect for that one cat who insists on sleeping on your laptop but also needs a backup plan.

title: Apocalypse-Ready Arterial Clogging
tagline: Forget gold bars; the *real* currency after the fall is cured pork belly. Individually wrapped, shelf-stable bacon. Perfect for bartering with wasteland scavengers who value crispy goodness over, say, medicine. Or, just keep it in your desk drawer for those days when existential dread requires a protein boost.

title: Wood You Believe It?
tagline: For the person who insists their data should smell like a lumberyard. Perfect for when you need to smuggle files into a sawmill or impress your boss with your 'rustic' file management skills. USB ports not included—because obviously, you're supposed to rub sticks together to transfer data.

title: Liquid Gold for the Bougie
tagline: When your toasted sourdough demands more than just 'extra virgin', this is the olive oil you pull out to impress your in-laws. Perfect for that one friend who insists on making balsamic reductions at home—because why not drop a grand on something that'll sit in your pantry for a decade? Comes in a bottle that looks like it belongs in a museum.

title: Yeast’s Luxury Condo
tagline: For the homebrewer who’s tired of their beer tasting like regret and science experiments gone wrong. This fancy fermentation system is like a five-star hotel for yeast—temperature-controlled, pressure-regulated, and with a built-in spa (aka the bubbler). Perfect for when you want to impress your friends with a ‘craft’ IPA that doesn’t taste like it was brewed in a bathtub.

title: Remote Ignition Anxiety
tagline: For those who left the house wondering if they remembered to turn off the stove, but for your car. Now you can sit in your office, sip your coffee, and remotely confirm that yes, your engine is indeed running. Perfect for the paranoid commuter or the parent who just can't trust their teen with keys.

title: D&D Coins for the Overly Serious
tagline: For when your Dungeon Master insists on tracking every copper piece like it's a crypto portfolio. These coins are perfect for the player who's more concerned about their in-game net worth than their actual bank account. Bonus: they make a satisfying clink when you're pretending to be a medieval merchant.

title: Skull Pearls for Goth Pirates
tagline: For when you want to accessorize your pirate cosplay with something that whispers 'I’ve seen things' instead of 'I shop at Hot Topic.' Perfect for that one friend who insists their last name is 'Von Dark' and won’t stop quoting *Pirates of the Caribbean* at parties.

title: Resistance is Futile, Your Keys are Not
tagline: For when you're lost in a dimly lit convention center, searching for the 'Trekkie Meetup' room. This Borg Cube flashlight won't assimilate your wallet, but it might make you the envy of the cosplay crowd. Just don't expect it to help you find your way back to the 21st century.

title: Lunar Lumberjacks
tagline: For the insomniac who dreams of launching their own DIY space program—from the comfort of their bedroom. These wooden rockets glow like they’re powered by fairy dust, not rocket fuel. Perfect for that late-night ‘I could totally build a spaceship’ existential crisis. Just don’t try to refuel with matchsticks.

title: Phone Leash for Overthinkers
tagline: For those who've lost their phone in the couch cushions one too many times, this holster is like a leash for your anxiety. Perfect for the paranoid commuter who needs their phone within arm's reach at all times—even while riding a unicycle through a farmer's market. Because nothing says 'I trust no one' like a phone tethered to your waist.

title: Ghostly Glow for Midnight Munchies
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm still awake at 3 AM' like a USB-powered Pac-Man ghost lamp. Perfect for those late-night snack attacks when you need just enough light to see your chips but not enough to wake your roommate. Plus, it’s the only way to make your desk look like it’s haunted by something adorable.

title: TARDIS Timekeeping
tagline: For when your tardiness is a plot point, not a personal failing. This clock will sync perfectly with your life's narrative—just don't expect it to match the real world's timeline. Ideal for the fan who's always 'just one episode behind' and needs a timepiece that reflects their commitment to being fashionably late.

title: Glow Up Your Nostalgia
tagline: Because nothing says 'I’m an adult with disposable income' like a lamp shaped like a Nintendo console. Perfect for those late-night gaming sessions where you need to see your controller buttons but don’t want to turn on the actual lights. Bonus points if you use it to read bedtime stories to your kids—just make sure they understand why Mario isn’t jumping out of the screen.

title: Mug Hug: Sweater Edition
tagline: For those mornings when your coffee needs a sweater too. Perfect for the office thermostat warrior who refuses to acknowledge 'business casual' extends to indoor climate control. Keeps your brew warm while silently judging your coworkers' poor temperature choices. Bonus: doubles as a subtle reminder that fall is coming, and so is your seasonal depression.

title: Wear Your Throne & Howl
tagline: Because nothing says 'I'm the alpha' like a DIY direwolf mask at your next corporate retreat. Perfect for when you need to assert dominance during a TPS report presentation or silently judge Karen from accounting. Comes flat-packed—because even mythical beasts need to save on shipping.

title: Shark Infested Sink
tagline: Because your kitchen sink was missing a toothy grin, this shark faucet cover brings a bite to your bathroom routine, perfect for when you're trying to make brushing teeth a thrilling experience for your kids.
